csvNullEncoding: Empty cell means unavailable event/failed fit, never a measured zero.

provenance.generator: Same JavaScript classical RK4 implementation; smaller step sizes only, NOT algorithmically independent.

truthParameterDistribution.distribution: independent uniform for each listed interval; bx=0

design.mismatch: Truth wind x uniform [-5,5] m/s, |y| uniform [3,8] m/s with alternating sign, z=0; fit fixes all wind components to 0.
design.populations: Two predeclared synthetic design populations, kept separate. Neither is a measured real-world football population.

sampleSchema.errors: {y_m,z_m,time_s} only if truth and prediction both reach; otherwise null

summary.interpretation: 围绕拟合模型生成独立高斯坐标噪声并重拟合；频率是该算法与噪声假设下的稳定性，不是现实进球概率
